title: Encoding a circuit’s quadratic PCPP proof
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits, and let $w$ be an assignment of Boolean values to its input positions. The encoded quadratic PCPP proof is the proof string obtained by joining the circuit’s quadratic extension of the quadratic witness associated with $w$ and the homogeneous quadratic proof encoded from that witness.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits
An input assignment $w$ of Boolean values
caveat: The constructions of the quadratic witness, homogeneous quadratic proof, and proof-joining operation are not included, so their precise mathematical content is unavailable.
